blocker_1.title: The maintained real-cluster regression harness cannot complete or fail unattended while a compute node is DOWN

measured.outcome: did not return; produced no output and wrote no evidence artifact
squeue_while_blocked: 76 debug hostname PENDING 0:00 2 (Nodes required for job are DOWN, DRAINED or reserved for jobs in higher priority partitions)
measured.oldest_leaked_step_note: a 5.47 hour old srun step from a PREVIOUS wave phase was still holding a pending allocation on the controller when this phase started
measured.root_cause: Invoke-LabSshCapture passes only SSH -o ConnectTimeout=5 and no command timeout, and an interactive srun step has no Slurm time limit, so the two-node srun gate pends forever instead of failing
measured.consequence: the regression gate can neither pass nor fail, so the wave can never obtain a truthful FREEZE-040 result by re-running it
measured.cleanup_performed: the two leaked pending jobs (76, 77) were cancelled with scancel and the local harness processes were stopped; squeue verified empty afterwards. No lab configuration, VM, disk or repository file was altered.

blocker_2.title: The maintained client CLI refuses every remote command because a global default-off security setting has no non-interactive opt-in

measured.harness: .tmp/w57-repair-112/w57_workstream_e_replay.ps1 (13 Workstream E scenario steps, deterministic, no human interaction, only the lab key PATH passed on the command line)
measured.result: FAIL - 12 of 13 steps refused in 0.6 s each, all with the identical error
measured.error_text: Remote CLI access is disabled. Enable "Allow external CLI access to remote commands" in Settings to use this command.
measured.setting: cli_external_access_enabled, load_settings().get(key, default=False) - a single GLOBAL application setting, default false
measured.no_automation_surface: the CLI exposes no flag and the repo defines no environment override for it; `profile create` and `profile update` expose only --host/--port/--user/--key/--host-key-policy
measured.secondary_gate: src/hpc_gui/cli/session.py:45 additionally requires a per-profile cli_allowed flag when a saved --profile is used
measured.why_this_is_repository_owned: docs/testing/LOCAL_HPC_LAB.md documents an unattended CLI procedure ('hpc-gui --profile lab doctor connection', 'doctor smoke', 'jobs list/submit/cancel') with a 'Verified on first build' PASS table, but the shipped default forbids every one of those commands and offers no unattended way to enable it. The lab profile emitted by lab/lab-up.ps1 carries "cli_allowed": false.
measured.why_this_was_not_worked_around: enabling cli_external_access_enabled is a deliberate change to a default-off security control and would persist beyond this run for the whole application. W57 rules forbid weakening permissions to turn a gate green, so the setting was left untouched and the refusal is reported as measured.

blocker_2.owner: CLI / settings owner (src/hpc_gui/cli, src/hpc_gui/config) - NOT W57 product surface; the doc/automation gap also needs the docs owner
blocker_2.bounded_next_action: either expose the control as a scoped opt-in (per-profile flag on profile create/update and/or an explicit documented automation switch) so an unattended regression run against a disposable lab is possible, or correct docs/testing/LOCAL_HPC_LAB.md to state that the CLI path requires a prior manual Settings action. The gate itself must not be removed.
